name: The St. Regis Longboat Key Resort
insider_take: This Gulf Coast gem sits on one of Florida's most exclusive barrier islands, where powder-soft beaches meet world-class luxury in perfect harmony.
whats_special: The St. Regis Longboat Key is the only luxury resort on this pristine 12-mile barrier island, offering unparalleled privacy and exclusivity. The property features the signature St. Regis Butler Service and sits directly on one of Florida's top-rated beaches with some of the finest white sand in the Gulf of Mexico.
pro_tip: Book a sunset dinner at the resort's oceanfront restaurant during turtle nesting season (May-October) for a chance to witness loggerhead sea turtles coming ashore to nest.
dont_miss: The nearby John and Mable Ringling Museum of Art in Sarasota, featuring one of the finest collections of Baroque art in America, and the spectacular bird watching at nearby Lido Key, where you might spot roseate spoonbills and great blue herons in their natural habitat.
pros: Signature St. Regis Butler Service for personalized luxury experience
Prime beachfront location on exclusive Longboat Key
Championship golf course and full-service spa facilities
Elegant oceanfront suites with private terraces
cons: Premium luxury pricing reflects exclusive market positioning
Secluded island location requires travel through Sarasota
